notes.description: Anything in scope that was NOT reviewed, and why. Empty string if full coverage.

findings.description: Empty array if nothing was found. Do not invent findings to fill space.

severity.description: P0 data loss/security/crash on a normal path; P1 wrong behavior on a reachable path; P2 wrong behavior on an edge case; P3 maintainability.

category.description: Short kebab-case slug, e.g. correctness, security, concurrency, api-contract, test-coverage, reuse, migration.

line.description: 1-indexed anchor line. Use 0 for a finding with no single line.

detail.description: Why it is wrong, citing the code.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete inputs or state, then the wrong output or crash. If you cannot write one, the finding is speculative - say so here.

confidence.description: Be honest. Speculative findings are welcome but must be labelled.
